articles.title: OpenAI's OpenWorks: Can Subsidised AI Training Turn Small Businesses Into Lasting Customers?
articles.meta: OpenAI's US OpenWorks pilot funds local AI experts and offers three free months of ChatGPT Business. We examine adoption economics, retention and the limits of the subsidy.
articles.profile_change: US OpenWorks pilot page lists 20 communities, partner stipend up to $8,000/month and three free months of ChatGPT Business; no Irish availability or conversion metrics disclosed.
articles.photo: Official OpenWorks case-study images have no established reuse permission; OpenAI Academy event pages and City of Renton AI Jam event listing found, but no verified licensed documentary photo of the programme or directly relevant workshop. Reject generic AI training stock and unlicensed promotional graphics.
checks: Primary pilot page lists 20 communities, counting 7 Midwest, 8 South, 4 West, 1 Northeast.
Stipend cap $8,000/month, not actual payment or number of partners.
Three months Business free; independently owned US SMEs; exclusions stated.
Hypothetical $8,000/20=$400; 20 x 25%=5 conversions; $8,000/5=$1,600; $1,600/$40=40 months; 10 conversions gives $800 and 20 months. No company CAC or margins inferred.

articles.title: Anthropic's Enterprise Frontier Safeguards: Who Pays for Private AI Monitoring?
articles.meta: Anthropic's 23 November Enterprise Frontier Safeguards beta moves encrypted safety records into customer-owned cloud storage. Examine privacy boundaries, review obligations and costs.
articles.profile_change: 23 November: Enterprise Frontier Safeguards beta for eligible organisations using supported API platforms, customer-owned encrypted safety storage and customer safety-case review; not unrestricted model access or a compliance certification.
articles.photo: CC0 photo of Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark speaking at Oxford 20 May 2026 identified (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jack_Clark,_co-founder_of_Anthropic,_giving_a_talk_on_AI_at_the_Schwarzman_Centre_in_Oxford.jpg), but no verified link to the actual safeguards topic or non-reuse/crop/bytes. No Dario, generic server or synthetic fallback.
checks: 23 November dated API release notes; beta and eligible organisations only.
EFS does not charge a separate Anthropic fee or alter API pricing; storage billed by cloud provider.
Sealed Safety Data is unreadable by customer; human review shifts to customer; feature-specific stored data excluded.
Illustrative review: 200,000 requests x 0.2%=400 cases x 9/60h x €70=€4,200; 0.05%=100 cases and €1,050; difference €3,150. No observed flag rate.
